topic: Optimizing Japanese server performance and setup
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on optimizing the performance of a temporary Japanese server instance. Initial testing revealed that the previous machine type (c7g.4xlarge) was bottlenecked by either disk I/O or network throughput while processing large datasets.

[me] requested an upgrade to c7gd.16xlarge, specifying requirements for maximum CPU, network, and disk throughput, with 16GB of RAM being sufficient. After setting up the upgraded instance, [me] demonstrated advanced data handling techniques, including manually mounting multiple local SSDs (`/data/ssd1`, `/data/ssd2`) to improve efficiency.

The conversation concluded with instructions for properly shutting down the high-powered Japanese server instance after use.
decisions: The temporary Japanese server was upgraded from c7g.4xlarge to c7gd.16xlarge for performance testing.
Multiple local SSDs were manually mounted and utilized on the new instance.
action_items: Properly shut down the Japanese server instance, ensuring cache is flushed.
